notes.title: v1.2 Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey dungeon builders,[/p][p]So after teasing you version 1.2 which includes Mac support and exciting new features, it's finally out!
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400770/Dungeon_Tycoon/"][/dynamiclink]Here's the full patch notes: 
[/p][h3]NEW PLATFORM[/h3][list][*][p]Mac Support is here!
[/p][/*][/list][h3]FEATURES[/h3][list][*][p]Overseer abilities (Player "skills" that can be unlocked through research and that use "mana"):[/p][list][*][p]Confusion: Deals confusion to everyone in the area[/p][/*][*][p]Dislocation: Allows you to carry a hero and drop it anywhere you want[/p][/*][*][p]Greed: Steals the contents of a chest[/p][/*][*][p]Aggression: Turns a hero into an enemy, which turns it on its own people[/p][/*][*][p]Healing Touch: Heals every hero in the area[/p][/*][*][p]Lightning: Casts a lightning that deals damage to everything in its radius
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/bb9575a6963cbaf53a34df19dcacfd7a6ed09441.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Room themes:[/p][list][*][p]There is a room theme for each realm, which also gets unlocked when the realm is unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Room theme can be changed/assigned from the room info panel
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/c358f75e2ca3a65e532b1d7b090b12c420e2f5cc.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]New Hero class (Rogue)[/p][list][*][p]Rogues dual wield the same weapon, and move much faster, and have the ability to turn invisible
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/481bc0474fb9046d0a44ca2e5adfb0952d988a9c.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]New grid objects (acquired through quests):[/p][list][*][p]Cave Berry[/p][/*][*][p]Danger Sign[/p][/*][*][p]Skull Spike
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]Popularity/rating/satisfaction has been reworked:[/p][list][*][p]Rating is now linked to the amount of heroes that come and the heroes' satisfaction level, and not to a percentage[/p][/*][*][p]Heroes' overall strength/level is now linked to max popularity (purple stars)[/p][/*][*][p]Heroes get progressively harder to please, but also bring more popularity[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]More monster limit research nodes have been added[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered walls are now allowed in build mode[/p][/*][*][p]Loot Goblin has been reworked:[/p][list][*][p]Now he starts with 200 gold, and drops 5 gold every second to the chests the in the room. He can only be killed now by heroes, in which case he drops all his gold like any other monster.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Objects such as camping spot, cauldron now also give happiness[/p][/*][*][p]Changed vendor stats to be more useful (added "earned today" stat, replacing "total earned")[/p][/*][*][p]Popup upon starting day if no research node is active[/p][/*][*][p]Refunding grid objects does not count as income anymore in the finance panel[/p][/*][*][p]Room "tags" now also show in play mode, for added clarity[/p][/*][*][p]A section for upkeep has been added to the finance panel for survival mode[/p][/*][*][p]Room stats have been reworked:[/p][list][*][p]Room satisfaction stat on the room panel has been replaced with the most occuring thought in the room[/p][/*][*][p]UI has been reworked for the room panel[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]"Not enough money" popup from heroes has been replaced with an image based popup[/p][/*][*][p]Death rate stat has been reworked to show the last 3 day average[/p][/*][*][p]"One-Way" toggle is not interactable when the day starts[/p][/*][*][p]Hero satisfaction indicators on the UI have been reworked to be more intuitive[/p][/*][*][p]Hero popups have been reworked:[/p][list][*][p]Upon leaving the dungeon, a popup of overall hero satisfaction is displayed[/p][/*][*][p]Upon changes in satisfaction, a particle effect is displayed[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New enchantment: "Mana Gem" for mana[/p][/*][*][p]AI/performance fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual improvements[/p][/*][*][p]UI/UX improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing improvements[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]
[/b]FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Heroes/monsters getting stuck/unresponsive bug fixed[/p][/*][*][p]One-way doors not working properly bug fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Daily costs tab displaying the wrong colors bug fixed[/p][/*][*][p]"rooms at max beauty" quest not counting rooms properly bug fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Status effects (buffs/debuffs) not taking effect bug (especially attack/movement speed) fixed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]More exciting features are coming soon, but in the meantime, feel free to share your feedback with us on Version 1.2. 
Have fun![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/ee736e1c53299f66c4a487c1ff3fda952b625e3d.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400770/Dungeon_Tycoon/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Version 1.2 Sneak-Peek #1
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there, fellow Dungeon Builders![/p][p]I hope you're all doing well. I know many of you have been patiently waiting for news about our next content update, and honestly, that patience means the world to us.[/p][p]The team and I have been working hard on this update, and I'm excited to share that we've finally reached the testing phase! Unfortunately, we didn't hit our Q2 timeline like we'd hoped, and I know that's disappointing. We felt that frustration too.[/p][p]What we've been crafting during this extended period is something we're genuinely excited about, and I think you will be too. I wanted to start sharing some of what we've been up to, beginning with something pretty special: [b]OVERSEER SKILLS![/b][/p][p]These new abilities will unlock through your research panel, giving you fascinating ways to influence the heroes' journeys – sometimes helping them along, sometimes... well, let's just say making things more interesting. Take a look at these icons and see if you can figure out what each skill might do. I'd love to hear your guesses!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/bc1c9989be603e9c37c2595bc79dced727faa2f5.png"][/img][/p][p]This is just the beginning of what we have in store. More reveals coming soon...[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us through this journey. Your support keeps us going.[/p]

notes.title: Dungeon Tycoon - 1.1.1 Patchnote
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
We've got some things to iron out following the 1.1.0 patch! Thanks for the warm welcome you've given this patch, and as always, a lot of really great feedback. It helped us make all those fixes, so we're really pleased to release this 1.1.1 patch!

Please find the full changelog below :

[list]
[*] The bug that caused the one-way doors not being saved properly has been fixed.
[*] Hero health has been buffed by 25% globally for balancing.
[*] The death rate on the overview panel displaying the wrong value bug has been fixed.
[*] Quest master achievement not being granted bug has been fixed.
[*] Stars achievements not being granted in survival mode bug has been fixed.
[*] Panels blocking the time control keybinds bug has been fixed.
[*] Buff vendors now also have upkeep costs in survival mode.
[*] Heroes don’t generate low health/energy thoughts if they have potions in their inventory.
[*] Heroes have been made invulnerable while interacting with vendors/consuming potions.
[*] Steamdeck keyboard not inputting the text bug has been fixed.
[*] The game now continues running in the background unless in Fullscreen mode.
[*] Overview mode satisfaction indicator now displays the correct value.
[*] Heroes now don’t stack buffs from vendors.
[*] Enchantment upkeep costs have been nerfed.
[*] Quest rewards now don’t count as income.
[*] Zoom in/out sensitivity has been fixed.
[*] Destroying a door causing pathfinding bugs has been fixed.
[*] Buffs/status effects not taking effect bug has been fixed.
[*] Minor UI/localization improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 + Roadmap announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today, I've got two things to tell you! Let's get to it right away.

First of all, we've seen that some of your are having concerns about game content. We've got a roadmap about content that will come in the next updates. Please find it at the end of this post! Since I've got more things to tell you and that the team made a beautiful visual for it, I'd want to keep your attention before you're diving into it!
As a precision, the content that's in this roadmap is planned as [b][u]free content[/u][/b]!

As the post title suggests, we're also rolling out the 1.0.5 patch! The main highlights of this patch is that we're keeping on working on crashes. Some of you had crashes on launch and we've tackle some of them. We're still working on some situations where it could still happen. We've also tackled some in-game crashes

One last thing before going into the full patchnote and roadmap, the 1.0.5 should be [u][b]Steamdeck Compatible, but not finished yet[/b][/u] as it's planned to be complete in 1.1 update.
In other words, before 1.0.5 you basically could not even launch the game on Steamdeck. The build should now be launchable on Steamdeck, but not optimized yet. There is a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2400770/discussions/0/4846526476120839420/]Steam Forum Post about the Steamdeck[/url], since while we know what it requires to be Steam verified with Steam verifications, we're also taking requests and feedback from you, the players, to have more than just the theory

Alright, I think I told you everything I had to, so please find below both the full patch note and the Roadmap!

Thanks for playing Dungeon Tycoon, and as always, for your precious feedback

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here's our second patch for Dungeon Tycoon! Since most of the crash situations seem to be fixed, we're focusing a bit more on balancing the experience.
Some people might still have crashes ; we're currently investigating on a compatibility issue for people using DirectX11/Windows 7. While using those does not mean you'll have crashes, this might be a cause of the remain ones. If you still have crashes but are not using DirectX11/Windows 7, please remember to have a look at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2400770/discussions/0/4846526093724394752/?snr=2_9_100015_] Steam Forum's Crashes thread[/url], so you can send your Crash logs our way to fix those! Thanks a lot

For this patch, as said, we're focusing a bit on balancing as we did not expect people to fly through the game's content. As we cannot add content that fast, to optimize the experience, we're slowing a bit the player's progression through it
There's also a bunch of bug fixes in there too. 
Thanks again for all your reports, I know I'm saying it a lot, but this is truly essential for us to give everyone the best experience possible.

Have a wonderful day, and please find the full patch note below :

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Popularity rebalancing
[*] Room prices were increased
[*] Balancing to research
[*] Nerfed groups by 25%
[/list]
[h3]General Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the two missing monsters to the spawn pool
[*] Fixed improved camping spots
[*] Fixed placing a room after placing a door wouldnt detect the room as reachable
[*] Fixes to achivements

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Crashes & bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First of all, thanks a lot for the warm welcome you gave the game. We're really thrilled that you are really hype about it!
However, the launch itself was not perfect. Some people are having a lot of crashes, sometimes with in-game pop-up, sometimes just with a Unity pop-up, but no matter how they ended up happenning ; this is far from ideal.
The main issue there was that we couldn't really reproduce the crashes on our test environments. However, thanks to you and your feedback, there's a lot of them we were able to tackle down (I don't want to say all of them for the obvious reason that we never really know, right). Moreover, we'd rather deploy this patch fixing a lot of the crashes as fast as possible, even if some might still be here, rather than waiting longer and having a lot of people experiencing the game negatively

If any crash situations happens again, please have a look at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2400770/discussions/0/4846526093724394752/]Steam Forum's pinned thread[/url] where there's a procedure on how you can send us your crash logs to help us take care of the remaining ones, shold there be some. Please note that even though we've tested this patch on our side, we also did for the game's launch, so we do apologize in advance should you still have trouble. We're doing our best to prevent this from happenning

Please find the full 1.0.2 patchnote below

Once again, we sincerly apologize to people that had those crashes, preventing them from having fun at all. Thanks a lot for playing Dungeon Tycoon, and see you for the next update(s)!

notes.title: Dev Diary #3 - Hero Groups, New Content, and End-Game
notes.notes:
Hello, dungeon builders! It’s been a while since our last update, but we’ve been hard at work adding new features and improvements. Here’s a glimpse at what we’ve been up to:

[h1]Hero Groups[/h1]
We’ve introduced the ability for your visitors to form parties and take on mightier monsters together! Grouping is a crucial tool for heroes to defeat high-level monsters and bosses. After all, what good is a cool skeleton boss if no one can ever defeat it?

Setting up hero groups is straightforward: simply research “Grouping Tables.” These tables serve as meeting points where heroes can rest, bond, and possibly form new parties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/0833157803ad3e099fffcdd9e582425b885fb721.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/7db2a72566928d504e5d55ef3c1695c92649aac9.png[/img]

With this new mechanic, dungeon building becomes even more dynamic. Consider researching tavern props and building a tavern inside your dungeon for that extra touch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/f3aa0b10a81868cc5df82c0ae3b5c2026556125a.png[/img]

[h1]Energy System[/h1]
Heroes now have energy meters that deplete with each action they take. Exhausted heroes will prioritize exiting your dungeon. To counter this, you can construct camping spots and energy potion dispensers to help heroes recharge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/46d028193277e356d5f3fc80f40c64ba8474b5d9.png[/img]

[h1]New Research Perks[/h1]
We’re expanding our research atlas with new perks that add depth and strategy to gameplay. Here’s a preview of some perks we’ve implemented:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/47f72c0b5bbdd49d986b2563436c043e63a45be0.png[/img][b]Boss Door:[/b] Unlocks a door only openable by a party.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/f3c799558fbae3fb76c2e72517836e1505ec5f82.png[/img][b]Elite Monsters:[/b] Increases the chance of spawning an elite version of a monster.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/b8cefb5a2e0e289a89a19a54468d1ac08b20e463.png[/img][b]Smithing Station:[/b] Adds a vendor where heroes can enhance their abilities permanently.


[h1]Queue System[/h1]
Visitors now exhibit more polite behavior. If they notice an object is in use, they’ll queue up to wait their turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/c3e85f0f0f93b349e2c97311fc8ebc4cc8098282.gif[/img]

[h1]Legendary Heroes[/h1]
Designed as end-game content, legendary heroes bring unique challenges and exceptional rewards. These special visitors will evaluate your dungeon’s standards before they visit. Meeting their high expectations will earn you substantial rewards, including unique buildable objects with magical properties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/75586ea27adf758b97bece945a91fae950de0f6b.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates!
- Dungeon Tycoon dev team.

notes.title: New demo update and publishing!
notes.notes:
The Goblinz Publishing team is excited to bring you some thrilling news! We're delighted to announce that we are partnering with Lunheim Studios, the talented developers behind Dungeon Tycoon, to take the game to the next level! We can't wait to share more news about our plans, but in the meantime, please enjoy the latest version of the demo - available now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400770/Dungeon_Tycoon/

[b][h3][u]FULL PATCH NOTES[/u]:[/h3][/b]

[b]Major Content[/b]

-Added new monsters.
-Added new buildable objects.
-Added new quest rewards.
-Added new research perks.
-Added a new class: The Wizard!
-Added ranged attacks for heroes.
-Added the loot goblin event.
-Made rooms inspectable.
-Room floors and walls can now be customized.
-Rooms can now be deleted.
-Hero AI has been completely reworked to allow for more natural decision making.
-Added item inspection panel to the build menu to show descriptions about the objects.
-Added a graph chart on the finances panel.

[b]Other Changes[/b]

-Deleting objects now refund money.
-Added tooltips.
-Added more rooms stats.
-Respawn pedestal now has a set amount of charges.
-Every hero now can give only one soul.
-Heroes can now be marked to follow them easier.
-Improved in-game camera.
-Switched to an improved input system.
-Improved scene lighting.
-Rebalanced some objects.
-Monsters now glow when they are max level.
-Overall performance has been improved.
-New icons for research perks.
-Everything is made easier to click and selects with larger hitboxes.
-New hero positioning system to make sure they don't overlap during fights.
-Added "View Monster" button to spawners.
-Visual UI improvements.
-Outline system for selections.
-Double door support.
-New hero gear.
-Right clicking now closes any open panel.
-Fights are made smoother.
-Doors now can be rotated.
-Log system.
-Ability to zoom in/out on the research panel.
-Totems now keep casting buffs as long as the heroes stay inside.
-1,2,3 and space keys for time controls.
-Improved the majority of the VFX.
-Lots of small QoL changes.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

-Fixed UI issues.
-Fixed potion dispenser bugs.
-Fixed heroes not facing the enemies.
-Fixed various bugs with the build system.
-Fixed flashing lights on torches.
-Fixed object options offset issues.
-Fixed floating texts not being positioned correctly.
-Fixed game-breaking bugs with the summoning system.
-Fixed enemies escaping rooms.
-Fixed monster spawn rates.

[b]Known Issues[/b]

-You can buy three monsters at the beginning, and then you have no gold and can't continue. If this happens to you, we invite you to start a new game.

For any questions or feedback, feel free to join [url=https://discord.gg/2Y2Hme5eBC][b]the Lunheim Studios' Discord server.[/b][/url] We're expecting many of you there!

Have fun!

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 - New AI, Classes, Monsters, and Future Plans
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Dungeon Masters![/h3]

Ever since we released our public demo, over 4,500 of you have played it! The amount of support we received is incredible and we can't wait to show you more of what's to come.

[h2]New AI[/h2]
We've completely overhauled our AI system! Introducing the new GOAP (Goal-Oriented Action Planning) style AI – it's not just more efficient, but it brings human-like adaptability to our game. Expect smarter decisions, more dynamic interactions, and an AI that's a breeze to expand and evolve.

In our internal tests, we managed to get unexpectedly high FPS counts even during our stress tests of over 100 heroes on the scene. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/81719ed962603822f12c1a99be3ee0488f214647.gif[/img]

[h2]Classes[/h2]
By launch, Dungeon Tycoon will feature four unique classes – Warrior, Mage, Ranger, and Rogue. Each with its own set of skills and stats, perfectly complementing our revamped AI. Imagine warriors bravely tanking damage, mages weaving healing spells, and rangers dealing deadly blows. Plus, we're working on a new grouping behavior. Heroes will soon be able to form parties, strategizing and combining their strengths to face the strongest foes your dungeon has to offer.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/b8fc921547ef064b9e2bf132124db808d0c44ebb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/102919602d574a5b3f7e87a59a6a0ed90a984b21.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/263ad28c4a5cf0c26105eee6db668d80248e4ea7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/5da326c747266f66e5780722f25a0d6fe846d5b6.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/15054f8fe769700ef552cf4eb98d9030c069e910.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/21de43144478c344560bf19b1b219607e8209baa.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Monsters[/h2]
We've been busy in the monster lab! Check out these incredible new additions to our bestiary:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/b1641fb46712fd9a64393b8c9ffd374200c8462e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/0ef702bf197a1231016b01e365022dc73bc77211.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/a1ef0ce080d41f3f25208909c60f78b84083a2c5.png[/img]
And drumroll, please... Meet our first boss, the fearsome Skeleton King!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/71685d174ef13f69ab15cc74a9d2806811b6bbb0.png[/img]


Our monsters are leveling up too – with about 10 unique skills planned for the next demo, expect more than just basic attacks. Each monster will have its unique strategic flair, changing the way you tackle each encounter.

[h2]Demo Update![/h2]
The demo will be updated soon as well! Even though it will not feature everything we mentioned in this dev diary, it will still be a really significant update. We'll try to polish and squeeze in as much content as we can without keeping you all waiting forever.

[h2]The Road Ahead[/h2]
We're committed to deepening the gameplay with new systems, quality-of-life improvements, exciting objects, and thrilling events [spoiler] (beware the loot goblins!) [/spoiler].

Stay tuned for more in our next dev diary. Your support and feedback are the keystones of our dungeon, and we're always eager to hear your thoughts. Together, we're crafting an unforgettable adventure.

Keep exploring, and may your dungeons be ever prosperous!

With gratitude,
The Dungeon Tycoon Dev Team

notes.title: Dungeon Tycoon Demo Retrospective
notes.notes:
[b]To our incredible Dungeon Tycoon community,[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/fc934b140a810d4b66555f0ac3c01bf2c63e74b1.png[/img]

Thank you so much for this incredible Next Fest, it has been truly incredible to have so many people try out our demo and show enthusiasm for it. This retrospective is born out of the incredible amount of feedback you have provided. 

[h2]Results of the Feedback Survey[/h2]

[b]80 people were also kind enough to fill in our feedback survey.[/b] Here are the results:

[list]
[*] More than 80% absolutely loved the demo. Only about 2% had a bad time playing it.
[*] Around 89% thought the game was easy to understand.
[*] Some 6% didn't like how the game looked. Ouch.
[*] More than 85% thought the game was easy.
[/list]

[h2]Key Concerns & Our Learnings[/h2]

From the myriad of feedback received, some recurring themes emerged:
[list]
[*][b] Longer Tutorial: [/b]We realized the importance of guiding our players more thoroughly in the early game.
[*] [b]Wall Visibility:[/b] Introducing options to minimize or hide walls for an optimized visual experience.
[*] [b]Hotkeys:[/b] Enhancing gameplay efficiency.
[*] [b]Camera:[/b] Making the camera usage more enjoyable.
[*] [b]Bugs and Behavior:[/b] Addressing glitches that affected gameplay, from major issues to the amusing 'negative visitor amount' anomaly we encountered.
[/list]

[h2]Demo By The Numbers (As of 16/10/2023)[/h2]
Your enthusiasm was evident:
[list]
[*] Amount of people that claimed the demo: 7,161
[*] Amount of people that played the demo: 2,658	
[*] New wishlists: circa 2,500
[*] Average time played: 54 minutes
[*] Median time played: 30 minutes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/5ce6cbe9fda0557020e3cf9822073b045365087f.png[/img]

[h2]The Road Ahead for Dungeon Tycoon[/h2]

[b]Realm System:[/b] We're in the midst of designing a captivating realm system, where mobs are summoned from various thematic worlds. Whether it's the searing heat or the chilling cold, each realm will immerse you in its unique ambiance, bringing with it creatures that perfectly encapsulate its essence.

[b]Code Cleanup: [/b]Game development can be a messy affair, especially when the clock's ticking. We’re taking a step back to tidy up our codebase and reevaluate some of those midnight-oil design decisions.

[b]AI Overhaul: [/b]NPCs are about to get a whole lot smarter and more interactive. Want the details? Keep an eye out for an in-depth devlog coming your way soon!

[b]Deepening the Lore:[/b] As a tight-knit team of three, every coffee-fueled brainstorming session counts. We're not just coders and designers; we're storytellers. And we're hard at work weaving intricate tales and histories that will breathe even more life into the world of Dungeon Tycoon.

[b]Mapping Out Adventures:[/b] Exploring new terrains? Absolutely on the cards! We're brainstorming on diverse maps to elevate your gameplay experience.


[h2]Behind The Scenes: Our Game Dev Journey[/h2]
Creating a game feels like navigating a maze sometimes—exciting paths, unexpected dead-ends, and eureka moments. To our fellow devs, you know the drill: that balance between experimentation and execution is always a thrilling challenge. And to our players, it's about turning those trials into a fun, engaging experience for you. We've been playing with ideas, sometimes scrapping them, other times refining them. Some of our behind-the-scenes antics might give you a chuckle! But it’s all in the spirit of crafting something memorable. Your patience and passion fuel our journey, and together, we're shaping the world of Dungeon Tycoon into a thrilling odyssey.
 
 Here are some images of our journey developing DT:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/ac1abd6839686cc136dfb1283c0d9f03ef30f86f.png[/img]
Crawler was born!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/3084e094130f6aec727b2dae34b8d5d4d97487b6.png[/img]
The hero and the crawler art test

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/45abbbde22ec798bf625cbf2a2ef51ab8b11088a.png[/img]
Grid system, item placing

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/c488e2de0a082db1d2ea399d37d9f8dc75038b0c.png[/img]
Room detection and darkening shader

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/751e1c04bb7d9f366deb4ecc8952e28d1cf3ffe3.png[/img]
Initial game design idea

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/9918a2e49c5a1149fa4550864a6b167e74ec51a4.gif[/img]
New look, new VFX

[b]...and the game today:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/c3bcafa2ad6c3126a43a679afb293575b98a6234.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/c152c144385bb3dc71cefb595a35d34da27022aa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/ad4f9a75255b0c304f5622a977ba752c6b7954a4.png[/img]
(Courtesy of our players on Discord)

[h2]Closing Words[/h2]

As we draw this retrospective to a close, it's hard not to be overwhelmed by the weight of the journey we've undertaken. Those initial moments, filled with simple joys like successfully placing walls in a line on our laptops, now seem both distant and deeply cherished. From humble beginnings to the burgeoning community around Dungeon Tycoon, the progression has been nothing short of magical.

Yet, as significant as this journey has been, we are acutely aware that an even grander adventure lies ahead. With the foundation we've built and the support of a community as passionate as you, the horizon is bright with promises and potential.

In closing, let us reiterate a sentiment that can't be stressed enough: thank you. Your encouragement, feedback, and sheer enthusiasm are the winds in our sails, the fire in our forge. Here's to the roads we've traveled, the dungeons we've delved into, and the vast landscapes yet to be explored.

[b]With profound gratitude and anticipation for the future,
The Dungeon Tycoon Team.[/b]

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 - Welcome Dungeon Builders!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, world![/h1]
Hi everyone! This is our first-ever Steam post. In dev diaries like this, we will be going over some of the things we've been working on. Please make sure to drop your feedback below, we LOVE criticism.

[h2]What is Dungeon Tycoon?[/h2]
Dungeon Tycoon is a management/strategy/tycoon game about building and managing your own dungeon. You will design layouts, hire monsters, fill your dungeon with loot, set up shops, and do much more. Dungeon Tycoon is all about attracting and making money off of adventurers all across the realm.

[h2]Build Mode Improvements[/h2]
One of the things we struggled a lot in the past few weeks was the build mode. But we think it is at a fairly decent state right now. Our current build system allows you to create rectangular walls, place various objects like traps, enemies, and loot, and also change the floor design.

Here's a cool gif:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/838025279e8396ff92ee2c966f2f76be31464b82.gif[/img]

We've been also working on the UI but I think we still need to do some more experimenting to come up with a final design. Still, I don't really want to spend too much time on the UI this early into the development.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/5188820f93ff831ae69cfa70412ad99b355905a7.png[/img]

[h2]Hero AI[/h2]
Heroes are the customers in Dungeon Tycoon. You have to make sure they keep coming and that they are having a good time. Building a scalable and clean structure for the hero AI is extremely crucial for us because these little adventurers are the key focal point of the game.

We have been working on the hero AI for a while now and I think it's shaping up quite nicely. For it to work, we are using a really neat framework that allows us to work with behavior trees.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/c49bde959e87cfa7d254f33c353f71e757565280.png[/img]

With this system, building a complex hero AI becomes less of a headache. It still needs a lot of work but for now, it just works and that's all that matters.

[h2]Art[/h2]
Even though the game is at a pretty early stage, we hate staring at untextured blocks. So I try to make sure that the art keeps up with the technical side of the game. Early art makes development easier since it allows us to picture the game more clearly, and also boosts our motivation quite a lot.

Here's a screenshot from the current version of the game. How do you like the look and feel of it?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/a235d310993e935b2291addcc7ab65f5bb33462c.png[/img]

I personally love the shader we have that makes the rooms with lots of fire in them look warmer by applying an orange filter. To achieve that effect, we simply create a volume inside the rooms and apply a simple color multiplier that dynamically changes depending on the amount of fire inside.

Another small but subtle detail I have implemented is the randomized textures. If you look closely, there is some slight variation in the texture of the walls and the floor tiles. I achieve this by creating a custom shader graph material that takes location as a seed and randomly selects a variant of the input textures depending on it.

Oh yeah, I also added moth for no reason. See if you can spot them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/f5c8debf8a5c77695a47ecb99059f28336cb6e4a.gif[/img]

[h2]That's All Folks![/h2]
That's it for this week. We have a lot more to show in the upcoming days so make sure you follow our Steam page and wishlist the game <3
